title: Smartphone-Aided VR Exergames for HIIT: Gamifying Fitness with Real-Time Pose Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces an innovative virtual reality (VR) exergame system designed to gamify High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) workouts through 11 predefined combo moves, including squat-punch combinations, bilateral arm strikes, and diagonal stretch combos. Unlike conventional tracking methods that often rely on wearable motion capture suits or limited headset-based sensors, our system uses a standard smartphone camera placed on a tripod to capture full-body movement. This approach offers a cost-effective and scalable alternative, particularly well-suited to the fast, dynamic motions typical of HIIT routines.   The smartphone footage is processed in real time using a pose estimation algorithm, with extracted biomechanical data analyzed by a backend server built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Anthropic's open standard for connecting AI models to structured data sources and tools, and a GPT-4o large language model. translated_title: 智能手机辅助的高强度间歇训练VR健身游戏：基于实时姿态估计的健身游戏化
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了一种创新的虚拟现实（VR）健身游戏系统，旨在通过11个预定义的组合动作（包括深蹲出拳组合、双臂挥击和对角拉伸组合）将高强度间歇训练（HIIT）游戏化。与通常依赖可穿戴动作捕捉套装或有限头显传感器的传统追踪方法不同，我们的系统使用放置在三脚架上的标准智能手机摄像头来捕捉全身运动。这种方法提供了一种经济实惠且可扩展的替代方案，特别适合HIIT训练中典型的快速、动态动作。智能手机拍摄的画面通过姿态估计算法进行实时处理，提取的生物力学数据由基于模型上下文协议（MCP）——Anthropic用于连接AI模型与结构化数据源和工具的开放标准——构建的后端服务器以及GPT-4o大语言模型进行分析。该系统……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用普通智能手机摄像头进行实时全身姿态估计的VR健身游戏系统，结合11个游戏化HIIT组合动作以及基于MCP协议和GPT-4o的后端生物力学数据分析，为高强度间歇训练提供了低成本、可扩展、无需穿戴设备的运动追踪与健身游戏化方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a VR exergame system that gamifies HIIT workouts through 11 combo moves using a standard smartphone camera for real-time full-body pose estimation, offering a cost-effective and scalable alternative to wearable motion capture, with biomechanical analysis powered by an MCP-based backend server and GPT-4o.
